info.name: AL BARAKAH LIFESTYLE API
info.description:
One REST API and one database for the website, the admin studio and the mobile app. Everything the admin changes (products, prices, stock, orders) is live for every client immediately.

**Base path:** `/api/v1` is the app contract (website, Flutter app and admin panel). `/api` is the same API with plain response bodies, used by the website and admin studio.

**Response format on /api/v1:** every body documented below is wrapped: `{ "success": true, "message": "…", "data": <body> }`. Lists with pages put the list in `data` and add `"pagination": { page, limit, total, totalPages }`. Errors: `{ "success": false, "message": "…", "code": "OUT_OF_STOCK", "errors": [{ field, message }] }` (`errors` on validation failures).

**Products** can be addressed by id or slug everywhere (`/products/{id}`, cart, wishlist, reviews). On /api/v1 products come in the app shape: one `price` in the requested `currency` (`?currency=INR|AED|SAR…` or `?country=`), `compareAtPrice`, `fragrance { family, topNotes, heartNotes, baseNotes, longevity }`, `rating`, `reviewCount`, plus every stored field (all prices under `prices`).

**Roles:** customer, admin, manager, support. Staff endpoints are under `/admin` and checked on the server.

**Auth:** `POST /auth/login` (or `/register`) returns an access token (JWT, 7 days) and a refresh token (60 days, rotated). Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; on `401`, call `POST /auth/refresh`, and if that fails, sign in again.

**Errors** are JSON: `{ "code": "OUT_OF_STOCK", "message": "…" }`. Branch on `code` (stable, listed in the Error model); show `message` to people. **Money** is in whole units of the order currency (INR or AED). Prices always come from the server.

See also docs/API.md in the repository for the token flow, conventions and mobile notes.

**Version:** 1.5.0 · generated 2026-10-29 from `/api/openapi.json` (205 requests).

**Start here:** pick an environment (Local or Production), then run **Auth → Sign in** (customer) to fill `{{token}}`; staff sign in the same way to fill `{{adminToken}}`. **Products → List products** fills `{{productSlug}}`/`{{productId}}`; creating things saves their ids for the requests that follow.

**Careful on Production:** these requests act on the live shop (real orders, emails, Delhivery pickups, WhatsApp messages and refunds).

request.description:
Create a customer account

Body: `name`, `email`, `password` (8+), optional `phone`. A phone already used by another account → 409. **Confirms the email once:** returns `{ verificationRequired: true, email, expiresInSeconds }` and emails a 6-digit code; finish with POST /auth/verify-email, which returns the session. Signing up again with an email still waiting for its code updates that sign-up and sends a new code. (Servers without email return the session straight away.)

**Responses:** `201` Signed in · `400` Invalid input. `message` says what to fix. · `409` Email already registered

item.name: Sign in with email or phone

request.description:
Sign in with email or phone

Send `identifier` (email or phone, e.g. +919999999999) and `password`; `email` instead of `identifier` also works. Returns `accessToken` (same as `token`), `refreshToken` and `user`. Blocked accounts get 403 ACCOUNT_BLOCKED. A new account that never entered its code gets 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED with `verificationRequired: true` and a fresh code is emailed. **Staff accounts (admin, manager, support), when the server has STAFF_TWO_STEP=on** (off by default), get no session here: the answer is `{ twoFactorRequired: true, challengeToken, sentTo, expiresInSeconds, resendInSeconds }` and a 6-digit code is emailed; finish with POST /auth/2fa/verify. Staff endpoints refuse staff tokens issued without the code (401 MFA_REQUIRED).

**Responses:** `200` Signed in · `401` Email and password do not match
